# Proto-Gospel of James Chapter 20 — The LOGOS Bible (Formal Equivalent)

**Translator:** LOGOS | **Source:** P.Bodmer V / Greek MSS, Proto-Gospel of James 20 | **Source Image:** source-texts/greek-EC/POX_020_page_001.jpg

---

## Chapter 20

**20:1** Now while Joseph was preparing to depart into Judea, there arose a great commotion in Bethlehem of Judea. For Magi had arrived, asking: "Where is the one who has been born king of the Jews? We saw his star in the east and have come to worship him."

**20:2** When Herod heard this he was disturbed. He sent officers to the Magi and summoned the chief priests into his palace, questioning them: "What does the Scripture say about the Christ? Where is he to be born?" They answered: "In Bethlehem of Judea — for so it has been written." And he dismissed them.

**20:3** He then questioned the Magi: "What sign have you seen concerning this newborn king?" The Magi replied: "We saw an extraordinarily great star shining among the other stars, so brilliant that it dimmed them — the other stars ceased to shine by comparison. From this we knew that a king had been born for Israel, and we have come to worship him."

**20:4** Herod said: "Go and search for him. When you find him, report back to me so that I also may come and worship him."

**20:5** The Magi departed. And behold, the star they had seen in the east led them forward until it came and stood over the cave. When they saw the infant with his mother Mary, they opened their pouches and presented gifts: gold, frankincense, and myrrh.

**20:6** Being warned by the angel not to return through Judea, they went back to their country by a different route.
